novel_features.name: Team-aware fixture filter
novel_features.description: Resolve a team name to all matches involving that team — answers 'when does Pakistan play next?'
novel_features.rationale: CricAPI's /matches endpoint takes a freeform search; no existing CLI applies that filter cleanly across upcoming + recent in one shot.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Translates the natural-language cricket query an agent or user most often asks into a single command, instead of forcing them to browse a fixture list manually.

novel_features.name: Today's matches with format filter
novel_features.description: Live and about-to-start matches now, with optional --format filter (t20i, odi, test, t20, t10, hundred)
novel_features.rationale: currentMatches returns everything mixed; the format filter is where CLI ergonomics actually win over the website.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Single command gives the agent the right shape of 'what's on right now' without paginating the whole match list.

novel_features.name: Live match watch loop
novel_features.description: Poll a match score on a loop with configurable interval; prints state changes
novel_features.rationale: No CricAPI endpoint pushes updates; a server-side watch is the only way to follow a match without manual refresh.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Keeps an agent in the loop on a live match without burning calls when nothing changes — only prints on score-state changes.

novel_features.name: Local series watchlist
novel_features.description: Track favourite series under friendly aliases; refresh all in one shot
novel_features.rationale: CricAPI has no concept of a user's followed series; the local store fills that gap entirely.
novel_features.example:
cricapi-pp-cli watchlist add ipl abc-series-id
cricapi-pp-cli watchlist refresh
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets the user pin a tournament once and refresh on demand — no other cricket CLI maintains local state at all.

narrative.headline: Live cricket scores, fixtures, fantasy data, plus the first cricket MCP server and an offline SQLite store for everything you sync.
narrative.value_prop: Wraps the CricAPI / Cricket Data REST API with team-aware queries (`team pakistan`), a local watchlist for series you follow, and a live-match watch loop. Every command is also exposed as an MCP tool — the first cricket MCP server, period.

quickstart.comment: drop in your free CricAPI key (sign up at cricketdata.org)
what's on right now, filtered by format
the natural-language query agents reach for

troubleshoots.fix: Run `cricapi-pp-cli auth set-token` and paste your key from cricketdata.org. Free tier ≈ 100 req/day.
Sync is paginated; re-run later or use --rate-limit 0.5 to slow it down.
Likely no live matches right now. Try `cricapi matches list` for the broader upcoming window.

narrative.when_to_use: When an agent or terminal user needs cricket scores, fixtures, or fantasy data and wants a structured response — not a scraped webpage. Strongest for natural-language queries like 'next India match', live match polling, and offline SQL over synced fixtures.

recipes.title: Next Pakistan game
recipes.explanation: Solves the canonical cricket-CLI query in one line, JSON-shaped for agent consumption.

recipes.title: Today's T20 internationals only
recipes.explanation: Filters the live/upcoming feed by format with agent-friendly defaults (JSON + compact + no-prompts).

recipes.title: Watch a match
recipes.explanation: Polls /match_info every 60s for up to 20 cycles; prints only when the score state changes.

recipes.title: Pin a tournament
recipes.command: cricapi-pp-cli watchlist add ipl <series-id> && cricapi-pp-cli watchlist refresh
recipes.explanation: Stores a friendly alias for a series in local JSON; refresh fetches the latest info for every pinned series.

recipes.title: Slim agent response with --select
recipes.explanation: When the response is verbose, --select trims to the fields the agent actually needs — keeps token use down.
